Name: Em's Tree Seed Birds
Author: Rivalrabbit
Description:
Tired of running around picking up tree seeds or bumping into small trees growing around your farm?
This mod stops the trees from dropping seeds, instead, wild birds gather them into a birdfeeder
Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url]﻿

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/3JXLF3PX/Howitworks.png[/img]

The trees don't spread seeds on the ground anymore (excluding palm trees)
You can still gather seeds from shaking or cutting down the tree
After reaching Foraging level 2, you'll get a letter in the mail from Marnie explaining the birds are the reason for the disappearing seeds
She gives you the crafting recipe for the [color=#e69138]Wild Bird Feeder[/color]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/MK7smzh0/Wild_Bird_Feeder.png[/img]

The bird feeder works as a small trade shop with the birds. You put an item in, and they leave you something.
Items you can put into the bird feeder are: [color=#e69138]Mixed Seeds[/color], [color=#e69138]Wool[/color], and [color=#e69138]Sunflower Seeds[/color]
After 2-5 days, the birds will have left you something
Most likely, you will get acorns, pine cones, and maple seeds
The more you increase your foraging level, the more items the birds bring you

Items to expect based on seasons and weather:
Mahogany seeds, Seasonal foraging seeds, Fiber and Mossy tree seeds
Items you can receive after reaching Farming Mastery:
Mushroom tree seeds, Ancient and Rare seeds, Golden Animal Cracker, Mystic tree seeds, and a Wild egg.

The birds have a preference for sunflower seeds, which are their favourite treat

There is no range in which the bird feeder works. The trees won’t leave seeds around even when you haven’t built a bird feeder. The bird feeder simply offers a way to get some of the seeds and other trinkets back from the birds

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/nVY7dMh9/Timber-Lunch-Egg.png[/img]﻿

Sometimes you might find a [color=#e69138]Wild Bird Egg[/color] when chopping down a tree, or even left in the bird feeder
These are hearty and strong eggs. Combine them with wheat flour and milk for a [color=#e69138]Timber Lunch[/color].
A Timber Lunch gives you a foraging buff for more work between the logs!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/W1HQ4bKW/CP.png[/img]

Download and install the latest [url=https://smapi.io///]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]Download and unzip "Em's Tree Seed Birds"
Move the folder to \Stardew Valley\Mods\
Enjoy!
